Done and Ignore are left out, and sorts and chooses show their first real way. zonesDiagram is removed. Proof screenshots were redone on desktop and phone, and the 390px wrap is checked. Focused tests and typecheck pass. The full vitest run has 31 failures, all in process/sandbox files outside this change.
